MATCH (a:Issue)-[l:BLOCKER|DEPENDS|DUPLICATE|SUPERSESSION]->(b:Issue)
WITH l, CASE WHEN type(l)='SUPERSESSION' THEN b ELSE a END AS s, CASE WHEN type(l)='SUPERSESSION' THEN a ELSE b END AS t
MATCH (s)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(p:Person), (t)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q:Person)
WHERE p<>q
UNWIND [[s.issueKey,p.personKey],[t.issueKey,q.personKey]] AS x
RETURN DISTINCT x[0] AS issue, l.linkId AS link, x[1] AS person, p.personKey AS id

MATCH (a:Issue)-[l:BLOCKER|DEPENDS|DUPLICATE|SUPERSESSION]->(b:Issue)
WITH CASE WHEN type(l)='SUPERSESSION' THEN b ELSE a END AS s, CASE WHEN type(l)='SUPERSESSION' THEN a ELSE b END AS t
MATCH (s)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(p:Person), (t)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q:Person)
WHERE p<>q
RETURN DISTINCT p.personKey AS id
